capabilities: search a local Zotero library by title, author, DOI, or keyword, or browse collections
insert Markdown deep links to Zotero items, PDF attachments, or individual annotations
use the current editor selection as the inserted link text
configure the local Zotero API address and collection column width in settings
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian >= 1.8.0; the plugin is read-only toward Zotero and never modifies its data. UI is available in English and Chinese and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search Zotero or link directly to a bibliographic item, PDF attachment, or specific annotation.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian desktop plugin that searches the local Zotero library and inserts Markdown links

requires.name: Zotero desktop with Local API enabled

summary: A desktop plugin that searches a running local Zotero library and inserts Markdown links to items, PDFs, or individual PDF annotations.
